description: Snippet.__post_init__ applies the rules for a NEW snippet (S1 title length, S2 expiry range) and SnippetStore.list_all builds every stored row through Snippet, so a row stored under an older, wider rule makes the whole list raise SnippetError once S1 or S2 is tightened. The #453 D1 defect. Detected when IC2 fails citing both files.
